title: How Many Triangles Have Perimeter 24? | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
Three whole-number sides that add up to 24: how many different triangles can you make? Vantee lists them by longest side, double-checks with a clever gap trick, shows why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you a new perimeter to try yourself.
